sources.title: RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The RadixArk Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 model is the quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. The quantization was produced at RadixArk using NVIDIA Model Optimizer, following a mixed NVFP4 W4A4 recipe.

sources.title: Architecture graph for RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 | hfviewer
sources.snippet: RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 architecture at a glance RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 is an image-text-to-text model (qwen3_5_text architecture). It uses 64 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,120, and 24 query heads with 4 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 17,408.
